in_sanskrit.name: Adhyanam
in_sanskrit.meaning: to contemplate, to study, or to learn
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The act of deep reflection, introspection, or meditation. It is the process of gaining knowledge or understanding about a subject through focused thought and study.

in_hindi.long_meaning: The act of gaining more knowledge or learning. It is the process of studying or contemplating a subject in depth.

in_telugu.long_meaning: The act of gaining more knowledge or learning. It is the process of studying or contemplating a subject in depth.

in_marathi.name: Adhyan
in_marathi.long_meaning: Adhyan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Adhyan is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘adhihyān’ meaning ‘to know, to learn’. This name signifies deep knowledge, wisdom, and understanding. In Hindu mythology, Adhyan is the name of a sage and a divine being associated with knowledge and enlightenment.
